issues.detail: The Greek 'εἰ ἔγνως' is a conditional ('if you knew') or a subjunctive expressing a wish, but the Vietnamese 'Ước gì' (I wish/If only) combined with 'ít nữa là ngày nay' (in a little while it is today) misinterprets the temporal structure. The Greek 'εἰ ἔγνως καὶ σὺ γέ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ σου ταύτῃ' means 'if you also knew in your day this [at this time/today]'. The Vietnamese adds a future-looking nuance ('ít nữa') that is not present in the Greek.
